d:
Rondae Hollis-Jefferson put on an ABSOLUTE MASTERCLASS against New Zealand at the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup!
RHJ went OFF, dropping 39 POINTS and carrying Jordan back into the game with one clutch play after another!
With just seconds left and Jordan trailing, he hit an INCREDIBLE three-pointer plus the foul to tie the game and send it to overtime!
The crowd was chanting "KOBE! KOBE!" as RHJ channeled his inner Mamba and delivered one of the most unforgettable performances of the tournament!
